messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!
Today from 12-2pm we will have a Zoom call where you can ask questions and get help with your R programming. Here's the link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/92807937862

As a reminder, you can post a question any time to  https://d-rug.discourse.group and the community will chime in to provide help. It may be more convenient for folks who can't make the Thursday calls.

-Wes
